newsitem.title: USA: Berkshire sees FY96 FFO $1.04-$1.06 range.
newsitem.headline: Berkshire sees FY96 FFO $1.04-$1.06 range.

text.p: Berkshire Realty Company Inc said on Tuesday that it expects funds from operations (FFO) to be $1.04 to $1.06 per share for 1996.
FFO is calculated based on the revised definition adopted by the National Association of Real Estate Investment Trusts (NAREIT) and is considered the primary earnings measure for equity REITs.

Berkshire previously capitalized acquisition fees paid to the former advisor and now expenses acquisition staff and overhead. The company said it is retaining more cash flow as a result of becoming self-advised.
